lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.text: You’re late. Same-day pickups are strictly between 17:00 and 18:00.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.text: Your file was returned to the queue overnight. If you still want a birth certificate, you’ll need to reapply through the regular channels.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.text: And no—there won’t be any more ‘special handling’ for you.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She stamps the paperwork hard and slides it aside.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.text: Standard (3 days) or Expedited (tomorrow). Those are your options.
